title: A Fixed Point Theorem for Random Asymptotically Pointwise Contractions
summary: This paper combines the decomposition technique ($σ$-stability) in random functional analysis with the deterministic theory of asymptotically pointwise contractions to provide a complete self-contained derivation of a fixed point theorem for random asymptotically pointwise contractions. We assume the contraction function is linear $ψ(t)=λt$ ($λ<1$) and focus on the linear case under the assumption that $G$ is bounded.
